QuestInfo.name: Food Storehouse Shortage
QuestInfo.0: It seems the Food Storehouse was compromised during the attack, and Salvo needs your help to restock it.
QuestInfo.1: Salvo could really use your help restocking the Food Storehouse with enough provisions to feed the whole refuge. Bring #i4036345# #b#t4036345##k x#b20#k from #o2400351# in #r#m402000611##k.
QuestInfo.2: You helped Salvo gather much needed food supplies for the refuge. No one will go hungry today!

default.0: We need #i4036345# #b#t4036345##k items from #o2400351# in #r#m402000611##k. About #b20#k should be enough to get us started. Oh, and would you reduce the number of #o2400351# while you're at it?
